svg.title: Reading Holman Fig. 6-5: laminar thermal entry at Gz⁻¹ = 0.088
svg.text: Reading Holman Fig. 6-5: laminar thermal entry at Gz⁻¹ = 0.088
Local and mean Nu in a circular tube, laminar flow; redrawn from the exact Graetz series
Gz⁻¹ = (x/d)/(Re Pr) = (7.23/0.06)/(696 × 1.96) = 0.088: mark it on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the q_w = const curve (uniform heat flux); at 0.088 it has flattened onto its asymptote.
Go across to the Nu axis on the left.
Read Nu_d ≈ 4.364 (fully developed; the redrawn local curve is 4.38 here, within 0.5%).
Redrawn from the Graetz-series solution; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
